title: NoFireOverlay
description: A slim, customizable fire overlay that keeps the vanilla flames from blocking your screen — see clearly while on fire and still know you're burning. Adjust opacity, size and position.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CURSEFORGE-F16436?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/nofireoverlay)

Client-side utility mod that replaces Minecraft's default fire overlay with a cleaner and much less obstructive version. You still get a clear visual warning that you are burning, but it no longer covers large parts of the screen or gets in the way of combat, movement, or UI visibility.

![Mod overlay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7320653628cf755aff77a7d47c145bf7add902a7_0.webp)

**Client-side only** (no server installation required). **Fully compatible with singleplayer**.

**📦 Free to use in any modpack** — public or private, no permission needed.

**🔥 What it does:**
- Replaces the vanilla on-fire overlay with a compact low-profile warning.
- Keeps the effect visible enough to clearly show that the player is burning.
- Greatly reduces interference with the HUD, hotbar, crosshair, and general visibility.
- Lets you adjust the overlay directly from the in-game mod config screen.

**⚙️ Configuration:**
You can customize the overlay through the mod configuration screen in the mod list menu.

![Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17b8b9c53dd90a715ae61f6332b297b3c30e2c1f_0.webp)

**📋 Details:**
- Client-side only.
- All settings are stored locally in your game config folder.
- Fully translated into 10 languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, and Italian.

**🐞 Please report any bugs, errors, or feature suggestions on Discord:** https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA
